groups.eeg_cost_notes:
Per-window EEG cost at 118 channels, T=1024. Each figure is the family-warm 118x1024 increment of the unit's first identifier plus the band increments times the EEG identifier count (units.yaml eeg_identifiers: 11 for the 9 undirected classes and psi, 10 for gd).

Undirected classes: the cache key holds the measure only, so the 11 bands share one build. phase 2.29+10x0.014=2.4 s, cohmag 2.66+10x0.015=2.8 s, icoh 2.42+10x0.015=2.6 s, plv 7.80+10x0.021=8.0 s, pli 3.5 s, wpli 5.5 s, dspli 3.7 s, dswpli 10.3 s, ppc 9.3 s. That is 48.1 s for the nine. Add 2.3-7.8 s more when the first spectral SPI on the Data pays twice through the first-insert string key.

psi and gd: the band is in the cache key, so every band pays in full. psi is 11 x 4.51 = 49.7 s; three of its EEG bands at T=1024 raise IndexError after paying the coherency. gd is 10 x 3.69 = 36.9 s.

Total spectral today: about 135 s per window (about 22 core-hours per 600-window patient).

With spectral_csm-shared-csm alone: the coherency is computed once for phase, cohmag, icoh and every psi and gd band. Coherence family about 3 s, psi about 10 s at summary scale (~5x; the micro measured 0.16-0.21 s per psi band after one 0.72-0.75 s coherency), gd about 30 s (1.2x). The phase-sync units are unchanged by it.

Adding spectral_phase_sync-1 brings the phase-sync six from 40.3 s to about 18 s. Adding spectral_csm-1 brings them to about 6 s (plv measured 9.6x) and the coherence family to about 1 s. Adding spectral_psi_gd-1 brings gd to about 6-8 s.

Overall that is roughly 135 s -> 25 s per window. These are order-of-magnitude estimates from micro-benchmarks and profile shares. The band variants were not timed separately.

The historical figures (gd about 47 s, psi about 14 s, coherence-family first variants 0.5-1.3 s, channel count unknown) are of the same order for gd. They are lower for psi and the coherence family, which fits fewer channels in those runs.

Memory bounds concurrency. Peak RSS at 118 is 1.66-3.07 GB per process (3.41 GB in a family-warm phase-sync run), which scales to 5.9-12.2 GB at 249 channels. The taper-level tensor is 1.14 GB at N=118 and 5.08 GB at N=249.

The directed units and sgc are not in the EEG selection.

refutations.problem: The risk_evidence says covariance_ is final before pinvh runs and that cov identifiers never read precision_. It leaves out that the cov identifiers overwrite the cached covariance_ in place: basic.py:49-50 runs np.fill_diagonal(matrix, np.nan) on the sklearn attribute itself. A lazy precision computed on the first prec/prec-sq request, after a cov identifier has run, would therefore invert a matrix with a NaN diagonal. pinvh with check_finite would raise, and the Calculator turns that into an all-NaN prec matrix (semantic).
